tasks.title: Docs figures come from results
requirements: every latency and heap figure in docs cites a results file and names its hardware

every quantitative figure in docs and the README (a time, a size, a rate, a count of tokens or notes) cites a results file and names its hardware, not only latency and heap; a figure from simulated traffic (the growth bench's 170 million tokens) says it is simulated and gives the stored size beside it

criteria.statement: A figure in docs that is not in a results file fails

SR-1.13 every figure: a fixture page saying 170 million tokens with no results file fails; with a results file but without the word simulated and the stored size beside it, it fails; with both, it passes
